description: This file declares classes and structures related to proxy auto-config (PAC) file decision logic within the Chromium project, including the PacFileDecider class which manages PAC script fetching and validation.

classes.name: PacFileDataWithSource
classes.description: Encapsulates PAC file data along with its source information, indicating whether it was auto-detected or explicitly configured.

classes.name: PacFileDecider
classes.description: Helper class that determines which PAC script to use based on proxy configuration, manages fetching, validation, and fallback logic.

methods.name: PacFileDecider(PacFileFetcher*, DhcpPacFileFetcher*, NetLog*)
methods.description: Constructor for PacFileDecider, initializes with fetchers and logging.

methods.name: Start(const ProxyConfigWithAnnotation&, const base::TimeDelta, bool, CompletionOnceCallback)
methods.description: Begins the process of evaluating proxy settings and fetching the PAC script.

methods.name: OnShutdown()
methods.description: Cancels ongoing DNS requests and fetches, does not invoke callback.

methods.name: effective_config()
methods.description: Returns the effective proxy configuration after evaluation.

methods.name: script_data()
methods.description: Returns the fetched PAC script data and source info.

methods.name: set_quick_check_enabled(bool)
methods.description: Enables or disables DNS quick check.

methods.name: quick_check_enabled()
methods.description: Returns whether DNS quick check is enabled.
